idh.reasoning: The metadata strongly favors an IDH-wildtype diffuse glioma: very advanced age (77 years), marked and extensive enhancement, necrotic component, large edema burden, deep white matter and ependymal invasion, and substantial mass effect/midline shift are typical of glioblastoma biology. Therefore the best estimate is IDH-wildtype.
